The `publish-plugin-update` skill runs the end-to-end release of a Federated Wiki plugin update — covering documentation, versioning, GitHub, npm, and the help/catalog pages, so a new version is shipped and discoverable in one pass.

1. **Docs** — update the plugin's `README.md` and refresh its catalog page on `plugin.fedwiki.club` (`agentprivacy-wiki-document-plugin`). 2. **Version** — bump the version in `package.json` (`npm version patch|minor|major`), following semver. 3. **GitHub** — commit the changes, tag the release, and push (commit + tag + push origin).
